options.name: app_environment
options.description: Key/Value pairs which will be added to the environment of the service application.

options.name: app_rotate_bytes
options.description: NSSM will not rotate any file which is smaller than the configured number of bytes.

options.name: app_rotate_online
options.description: If set to 1, nssm can rotate files which grow to the configured file size limit while the service is running.

options.name: app_stop_method_console
options.description: Time to wait after sending Control-C.

options.name: app_stop_method_skip
options.description: To disable service shutdown methods, set to the sum of one or more of the numbers 1 - Don't send Control-C to the console. 2 - Don't send WM_CLOSE to windows. 4 - Don't send WM_QUIT to threads. 8 - Don't call TerminateProcess().

options.name: application
options.description: The application binary to run as a service Required when I(state) is C(present), C(started), C(stopped), or C(restarted).

options.name: arguments
options.description: Parameters to be passed to the application when it starts. This can be either a simple string or a list.

options.name: dependencies
options.description: Service dependencies that has to be started to trigger startup, separated by comma.

options.name: description
options.description: The description to set for the service.

options.name: display_name
options.description: The display name to set for the service.

options.name: executable
options.description: The location of the NSSM utility (in case it is not located in your PATH).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the service to operate on.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to be used for service startup. This is not required for the well known service accounts and group managed service accounts.

options.name: start_mode
options.description: If C(auto) is selected, the service will start at bootup. C(delayed) causes a delayed but automatic start after boot. C(manual) means that the service will start only when another service needs it. C(disabled) means that the service will stay off, regardless if it is needed or not.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the service on the system.

options.name: username
options.description: User to be used for service startup. Group managed service accounts must end with C($). Before C(1.8.0), this parameter was just C(user).

options.name: working_directory
options.description: The working directory to run the service executable from (defaults to the directory containing the application binary)
